args.text: Can you put together every open or recent ticket and feature request on Marrow Agrisupply and Marrow Fieldworks? Pull from our team channels and Moss's Central notes, and label each one by account. I need the list for the Marrow review on Thursday.

@hollis.mbeki here's the Marrow ticket and feature request list from #central-team and Moss's Central notes. I found nothing for Marrow Fieldworks in either source, so it's empty.

MARROW AGRISUPPLY
- PD-4821: Eastbank receiving-door import. The file labels doors E1/E2, the booking sheet uses 01/02. Needs fixing before any reimport to avoid duplicates. Source: #central-team, 9 Jun 2026. Open as far as the channel shows.
- Pine Crossing shift issue: the appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift, so morning bookings can't be made. Source: #central-team, 9 Jun 2026. No ticket number given; Hollis planned to check the shift template and have support reproduce it.
- Store-by-store rollout blockers: the store list is still pending. Priyanka was collecting names, shift times and blockers from each store's receiving lead. Source: #central-team, 9 Jun 2026. No list has been posted in the channel yet.
- FR-882: custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for seasonal fertilizer sheds. Routed to the product backlog for Q2 review. Source: Moss's Central handoffs digest, 2 Jan 2026. Status after Q2 unknown.

UNLABELED (account not named in the source)
- #4409: recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard (Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron, 06:00 flatbed intake). Source: Moss's 2 Jan 2026 digest, which calls it "Pree's dealer account". Account not named, so I haven't labeled it.
- #4412: driver SMS prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on the unpaved overflow lot. Same source and same caveat.

NOT INCLUDED
- #88412 (Tansleigh Packaging, Jul 2025) is not a Marrow account.
- I only read the Central team sources you named. I didn't pull the North digests.

I can't see any ticket status beyond what's in these messages, so please check the tracker before Thursday.

I posted the list in #central-team as a reply to your message.

It has four Marrow Agrisupply items: PD-4821 (Eastbank door labels), the Pine Crossing morning-shift problem, the store-by-store blocker list that is still pending, and FR-882 (pallet-jack icons). I found nothing for Marrow Fieldworks in the Central channel or Moss's Central notes, so that section is empty.

Two tickets from Moss's January digest, #4409 and #4412, don't name an account. I listed them separately and didn't guess a label. The digest mentions "Pree's dealer account," so someone on the team can confirm which account they belong to.

I only read the Central sources you named. Statuses are as of the latest messages, so please check the tracker before Thursday.
